# Research — Context

This folder is historical record. The POV memos (`pov-memos/`) and disagreement map are the founding documents that produced the v2 skill's design rules.

**Do not edit these files.** They are a snapshot of the design process, not living documentation.

To understand a specific framework rule, check `pov-memos/disagreement-map.md` — each load-bearing disagreement maps to a rule in `../skill/`.

## Agents

`agents/` contains the four POV sub-agents used to generate the memos. Re-run them if you're doing a fresh research phase for a major framework decision — each agent answers the same six questions from a different lens (engineer, writer, practitioner, skeptic), then you synthesize a new disagreement map.

To build a function, go to `../functions/`.
